title: SubagentResultV1
description: Structured result every release-sdk Codex subagent must return instead of a full transcript. Raw logs stay in a temp file; only path + relevant excerpt + conclusion come back to the parent.

summary.description: At most 8 lines. Does not repeat the prompt.

requested_paths.description: Only set when status = needs_scope_expansion — the additional allowed_paths the orchestrator should grant before this agent can finish.

reason.description: Only set when status = needs_scope_expansion — why the current allowed_paths are insufficient (e.g. a direct import outside scope).
